intro: Everything you need for aerobic base building — nothing you don't.

items.title: Real-Time Zone Coaching
items.text: Your Apple Watch shows your current HR zone live — with haptic and audio cues when you drift out of your target.

items.title: MAF 180 Built In
items.text: Enter your age, get your zones. The Maffetone method removes the guesswork from aerobic base building.

items.title: Training Analytics
items.text: Cardiac drift, HR recovery, zone distribution, and weekly trends — see your aerobic fitness improve over time.

items.title: iPhone + Apple Watch
items.text: Start runs from your wrist. Review history, stats, and settings on your phone. Everything syncs automatically.

items.title: Live Activities
items.text: Track your zone from the lock screen and Dynamic Island without raising your wrist or opening the app.

items.title: Completely Private
items.text: No accounts, no tracking, no analytics. Your data stays on your device and syncs only to your own iCloud.
